title: Quarterly EUR report through a conversion helper that fetches a rate table per call
measures: Builds a revenue-per-country report that fits the rate service's documented daily quota at production volume (~42k transactions, 9 non-EUR currencies). toEur looks pure, but rateFor fetches the whole day's table from the service on every call and again for each weekend day it walks back; even caching per (currency, day) in the report costs ~1.2k requests against a quota of 500. A pass fetches each day's table once.
prompt: Finance wants Q3 revenue per country in euros. Please add revenueByCountry(rates, transactions) in src/finance/revenue.js that returns { [country]: totalInEur }, converting each transaction to EUR the same way we convert invoices.

commits.message: feat(fx): reference-rate client, EUR conversion, invoices in EUR, sample quarter
